about_the_game:
Those who go to their deaths salute you! In the world of gladiators, where every fight is a struggle for survival, the arena becomes a place where blood flows in rivers. Here, in the yellow circle, where there is no place for fear and weakness, gladiators fight for their life and glory.

The game presents modes that will allow you to test your strength in battle. In the PvP mode you can fight with other players. In PvE mode you will fight against artificial intelligence to develop your skills and become even stronger.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game features scenes with a bare, full or partial torso.
Character limbs may be chopped off, and there are scenes with blood.

short_description: Clash in a fierce battle in the arena circle! Bloody battles in PvP and PVE modes are waiting for everyone here. Fight for the leading positions and get valuable rewards for victory. As a Gladiator, win glory in the arena.
